# FUSED PRODUCTIONS - SUBCONTRACTOR AGREEMENT & SLA

## 1. Engagement & General Terms

This Subcontractor Agreement is entered into by and between **Fused Productions** ("General Contractor") and the undersigned Subcontractor ("Partner/Vendor"). This document establishes the strict service level agreements (SLAs), operational standards, and compliance rules required to perform work under Fused Productions events.

## 2. Compliance, Insurance & Documentation

Prior to receiving any event assignments or deployment run-sheets, the Subcontractor must submit:

- A verified, current W-9 form.
- A Certificate of Insurance (COI) establishing commercial general liability coverage, explicitly naming **Fused Productions** as an additional insured.
- Executed copies of all safety and compliance waivers required by the host venue.

## 3. Operational Standards & Punctuality

- **Centralized Dispatch:** Subcontractors agree to strictly follow the synchronized run-sheets, load-in windows, and sound check schedules distributed through the Fused Productions Vendor Portal.
- **Presentation & Conduct:** All on-site personnel must adhere to professional dress codes, conduct themselves with courtesy toward clients and guests, and maintain clean work areas at all times.
- **Zero Tolerance for Unscheduled Delays:** Failure to meet designated load-in windows without prior coordination with the Fused Productions general manager will result in immediate financial penalties or contract termination.

## 4. Invoicing & Milestone Payouts

Subcontractor invoices must be submitted directly through the Vendor Portal immediately following event wrap and tear-down sign-off. Payouts are released systematically in synchronization with client milestone draws.
